about: A passage of code in a panel, one ink per token kind, with a header for the file name and the controls. Given `before`, the block renders the diff from that version to the code.

colours.about: Each of the eight terminal colours takes an ink of the theme, so the output reads in both colour modes. A bright colour renders as its plain twin, and the output ignores a background colour.
colours.title: Terminal colours

file.about: A component file with `CodeBlock.Copy` in the header. The copy control reads the code from the root, so the passage is written once. The panel is dark by default on any page.
file.title: A file

languages.about: JSON, shell and YAML, each highlighted on the first paint. A language the highlighter does not know renders as plain text.
languages.title: Languages

modes.about: `dark` is the default on any page, `light` is light on any page, and `inherit` follows the page. Switch the page's mode to see the third block change.
modes.title: Modes

plain.about: A log without a language, rendered in the code text style with no token colours.
plain.title: Plain text

policy.about: A text without a language, in the page's colour mode. `context={Infinity}` shows every line, and the words a screen reader hears come from the locale.
policy.after:
Refunds are issued within 30 days of a request.
A refund goes back to the card used for the purchase.
Shipping costs are refunded for faulty items.
Start a refund from the order page.
policy.before:
Refunds are issued within 14 days of a request.
A refund goes back to the card used for the purchase.
Shipping costs are not refunded.
Contact support to start a refund.
policy.title: The whole text

review.about: A change to `src/retry.ts` with `CodeBlock.DiffStat` in the header. Unchanged lines more than three lines from a change fold into a button, which shows them and moves focus to the first. A changed line marks the words it gained or lost in their syntax inks.
review.title: A pull request

rewrite.about: Lines that share less than 35% of their text change as a whole, because the characters two unrelated lines share are not edits.
rewrite.title: A rewrite

size.about: Both sizes of the code text style. The title is one size smaller than the code.
size.title: Sizes

split.about: `mode="split"` puts the earlier version beside the later one, one row per pair. A side without a line takes the subtle fill, and each side scrolls with the other.
split.title: Side by side

terminal.about: `language="ansi"` renders a process's output in the colour, weight and underline its escapes set. Every other escape is dropped, and `CodeBlock.Copy` copies the text without escapes.
terminal.title: Terminal output

title: Code block

unchanged.about: Where both versions are the same, the diff renders `emptyLabel` and the counts read +0 −0.
unchanged.title: Nothing changed

words.about: Each edited value is marked inside its line, so a reviewer reads which field changed without comparing the two lines.
words.title: Changed words

wrap.about: `wrap` breaks a long line at the panel's edge in place of scrolling it sideways, inside a word where a path or an address has no other break.
wrap.title: Wrapping
